chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, who said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a group who went out and killed some of the Muslims, and demolished the mosques, and indeed al-Mustawfi Harun sent to them, so they were captured and killed, and the women and children were taken as captives. Is it permissible to buy any of them and have intercourse with them? He said, 'There is no harm in buying their belongings and their captives.'

key_terms.هَارُونَ: Harun (referring to Harun al-Rashid or a specific official named Harun)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on buying and having intercourse with women and children captured from a specific group of Muslims who killed others and demolished mosques?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) ruled on the status of women and children captured from a group that killed Muslims and demolished mosques. He clarified that it is permissible to purchase them as captives and have sexual intercourse with them, distinguishing their status as spoils of war.
